title: Exception
description: An accepted, time-limited exception for a real CVE in an artefact we publish. Distinct from VEX (which asserts non-impact in stackvista/vexhub) and distinct from Trivy's .trivyignore.yaml (which would auto-apply silently).

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema. Used by IDEs (IntelliJ, VS Code, etc.) for native validation and autocomplete.

schema_version.description: Exception schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

id.description: CVE id or vendor advisory id (e.g. CVE-2026-2332, SUSE-SU-2026:1040-1).

consumer.description: Consumer repo this exception applies to (e.g. docker-images, helm-charts).

image.description: The downstream image name we publish, e.g. quay.io/stackstate/kafka.

source_image.description: For retag-only images, the upstream source image (e.g. AppCo).

source_digest.description: For retag-only images, the upstream manifest digest the exception is bound to.

paths.description: Optional file paths inside the image where the vulnerable component lives.

reason.description: Short machine-friendly reason code, e.g. preserve_appco_provenance.

expires.description: ISO date after which the exception expires and the gate fails again.

owner.description: GitHub team or user owning the exception, e.g. @StackVista/observability-team.

upstream_owner.description: Upstream maintainer responsible for the fix, e.g. suse_application_collection.

upstream_reference.description: Link to the upstream tracking issue, advisory, or thread.
